meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "attack Active Directory", "exploit AD", "Kerberoasting", "DCSync", "pass-the-hash", "BloodHound enumeration", "Golden Ticket", "Silver Ticket", "AS-REP roasting", "NTLM relay", or needs guidance on Windows domain penetration testing.

copy.tagline_en: Attack and test Active Directory domain security

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能指导你攻击 Windows 域环境，包括侦察、凭据窃取、Kerberos 攻击、横向移动、提权等渗透测试操作。
howto.when: 当你提到“攻击 Active Directory”、“Kerberoasting”、“DCSync”、“BloodHound 枚举”等关键词，或需要 Windows 域渗透测试指导时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 BloodHound 枚举域环境。
如何进行 Kerberoasting 攻击？
用 Mimikatz 制作黄金票据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you in attacking Windows domain environments, including reconnaissance, credential harvesting, Kerberos attacks, lateral movement, privilege escalation, and other penetration testing operations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "attack Active Directory", "Kerberoasting", "DCSync", "BloodHound enumeration", or need guidance on Windows domain penetration testing.

say_en.text: Help me enumerate the domain with BloodHound.
say_en.note: Claude will provide SharpHound or bloodhound-python commands.

say_en.text: How to perform a Kerberoasting attack?
say_en.note: Claude will provide GetUserSPNs.py or Rubeus commands.

say_en.text: Create a Golden Ticket with Mimikatz.
say_en.note: Claude will provide the kerberos::golden command and parameters.
